senses.gloss: f. (מָאַס) rejection, contempt; use of the verb מָאַס.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:22">Lam. R. to V, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 332">Yalk. Is. 332</cite>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:22">Lam. R. to V, 22</cite> (ref. to <he>מאס</he> <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:22">ib.</cite>) <he>אם מ׳ לית היא סבר וכ׳</he> if it be a rejection, there is no hope (of a reconciliation), but if it be anger, there is hope.
